name: boj_get_money_supply
description:
Japanese broad money in yen, monthly, from the IMF's monetary statistics (MFS_MA, JPN.BM_MAI.XDC.M), read through SAJHA's shared SDMX client. FRED's Japanese M1 and M2 ended in 2017 and M3 in 2023, so they are not offered.
Returns: series_code (FRED id, or IMF flow.key), series_id, label, source, observation_count and observations (date, value) oldest first, missing values dropped.
Inputs (none required): aggregate (broad_money; default broad_money); start_date, end_date (YYYY-MM-DD); recent_periods (1-500; default 10; the last N observations, used only when neither date is given).
For prices use boj_get_inflation. IMF series need no key.
Example: {"aggregate": "broad_money", "recent_periods": 12}

recent_periods.description: The last N observations; used only when neither date is given
